summary: Tested newsletter premium preview / test-send / edit / send-all / cron. Backend 10/10 pytest passed. Desktop UI flow fully works (auto-open preview after 'Sedmični pregled', premium template with logo/date/label/subject/hero image/'Još iz pregleda' thumbnails/CTA/footer 'Odjavi se', no broken images, Desktop/Mobile toggle 680->380px, save updates iframe + list, test email toast 'Probni e-mail poslan na jonuzovicaldin7@gmail.com', send-all with 0 subs -> 'Nema potvrđenih pretplatnika', row 'Pregled' buttons open dialog). FAILED: preview dialog at 390px mobile viewport - content overflows horizontally and is clipped.

minor.issue: With 0 matching subscribers it still inserts a campaign and marks it 'sent' (recipients 0). Daily cron will clutter campaign list with empty 'sent' campaigns. Skip insert when no confirmed subscribers for that frequency.
Non-existent id returns 409 'Poslana kampanja se ne može mijenjati' instead of 404.

ui_bugs.issue: Dialog content overflows horizontally: iframe has fixed width 680 (desktop mode) / 380 (mobile mode) but available width is ~340px; with 'flex justify-center' the overflow is cut on the LEFT (iframe left=-15px in Mobitel mode, unreachable) and right side is clipped (DialogContent overflow-hidden). The left form panel collapses to ~140px tall internal scroller (grid max-h-[88vh] with single column), so subject/intro/save/test buttons are squeezed. Fix: on <lg make the dialog body a single overflow-y-auto column (remove max-h on grid rows / let left panel take natural height), add min-w-0 to the right panel, set iframe style width: mobile ? 380 : 680 with maxWidth:'100%', and replace justify-center with mx-auto on iframe (avoids left-clipping).

issues: Template looks premium on desktop; no issues. Section label 'Još iz pregleda' is uppercase via CSS (fine).

action_items: Fix NewsletterPreview mobile layout (390px): no horizontal overflow, iframe max-width 100%, whole dialog scrollable vertically, left panel natural height
auto_digest: do not create/send campaign when there are 0 confirmed subscribers for that frequency
PUT campaign: return 404 for unknown id
critical_code_review_comments: Moderation.jsx send(): uses window.confirm (browser native) - consider shadcn AlertDialog for consistency
Subscriber 'obriši' button in NewsletterAdmin lacks data-testid and confirmation
Manual 'Pošalji svima' ignores subscriber frequency (sends to all confirmed) - acceptable but should be stated in UI
Unsaved edits in preview are not used by 'Pošalji svima' or test email (they use stored version) - consider auto-saving before test/send or warning about unsaved changes
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ campaigns and one TEST_xxx@example.com confirmed subscriber (inserted directly, deleted after send). Cron-created 'Automatski' campaign deleted. All TEST data cleaned up; pre-existing campaign a538cf2a untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test email endpoint was called 2 times (1 pytest + 1 UI) - real email to owner; avoid calling more. Run pytest with '-n 0'. window.confirm on 'Pošalji svima' must be accepted via page.on('dialog'). Only mobile layout of preview dialog needs retest.
